scripts.sidecar:release:arm64: cd sidecar && CGO_ENABLED=1 MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 GOARCH=arm64 CC='clang -arch arm64' go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -o ../apps/desktop/resources/bin/arm64/ollupid ./cmd/ollupid
